title: Transcript coverage is reported, and zero coverage refuses (R1012)
body:
Implements `docs/plans/oracle/transcript-coverage-guard.md` — **OD-23 / R1012**, evidence **BL-27**, filed and ruled this session.

`select` ran twelve minutes before `fetch` finished, wrote 285 rows with no mentions at all, and said nothing. `estimate` then printed a zero-token projection closing with R7's "The pipeline STOPS here" — **the same output a finished run produces**.

**`Selection` gains `has_transcript`**, set at the one line in `select_all` that can tell a cached empty transcript from the stand-in it substitutes. Never inferred from the mention count: a cached transcript naming no board is real coverage, not a miss, and conflating those is the confusion the flag removes.

**Recorded, not re-derived per stage.** R1012 asks the projection to print "the same coverage figure" — and the two populations already differ, `select` counting pending videos and `estimate` only included selections. One datum written once cannot disagree with itself.

**Both stages print coverage on every run**, not only when something is wrong. A figure that appears only on failure is a figure nobody can compare across runs, which is precisely why BL-27's collapse was invisible.

**Zero coverage over a non-empty population refuses**, names `fetch`, exits 1. In `estimate` the refusal REPLACES the projection block rather than appearing above it — BL-27's whole finding is that a warning beside the checkpoint's own success language annotates it instead of separating it. Nothing is written on a refusal.

**An empty population is not a refusal.** Zero of zero is emptiness, not absence — the line R1005 already drew one layer down.

Two test helpers gain `has_transcript=True` as a keyword default: every existing fixture describes a video whose transcript was read, which is what having mentions means. The schema test's key set gains the field and **stays an exact-set assertion** — widening it to a subset check to accommodate one addition would retire the test that catches a stray key.

550 passing.

Carries a merge of the base branch so the required checks run against the tree this will land on.
